_about: Medical tree agreed with the owner. Thresholds 0/5/10/20/25. Packed integer ranks travel in the unused native armored_trap modifier (43); client medical_skills decodes them. Supply Pocket excludes the existing equivalent and Terminator. Native gameplay hooks must ship with this content.
